title: Gcp Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong Google Cloud Platform (GCP) expertise to design, build, and scale modern cloud-native data solutions and platforms. The ideal candidate has experience building production-grade data solutions on GCP, along with strong programming, data engineering, and distributed systems fundamentals. Strong experience with BigQuery and at least one messaging, streaming, or distributed data processing technology such as Pub/Sub, Kafka, Spark, or PySpark . Strong programming experience with Python . Experience designing and developing data pipelines, distributed data processing, and high-volume data workloads . Experience with Apache Airflow or a comparable workflow orchestration platform . Understanding of cloud architecture and data integration patterns, including batch and event-driven processing, data storage, scalability, and resiliency. Experience with production engineering practices, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, automated testing, and CI/CD . Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field , or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience with additional GCP data services such as Cloud Spanner, Dataproc, and Bigtable . Experience with Spark/PySpark and large-scale distributed data processing. Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies. Experience designing distributed systems, microservices, and RESTful APIs . Knowledge of software design fundamentals, including object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and API design . Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tooling such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Maven . Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift . Experience with data quality, governance, security, and observability practices in cloud data platforms. title: Senior Associate - Data Engineer (Data Business CoE)
description:
About us Bain & Company is a global management consulting that helps the world s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry. In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bains case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 
 Who you will work with OPEXEngine, a Bain & Company solution, is a proprietary B2B SaaS benchmarking database covering 1,200+ participating SaaS companies, 250+ metrics, and 130,000+ validated data points. The platform ingests customer submissions, calculates financial, SaaS, go-to-market, headcount, and operating expense metrics, and publishes cohort-level benchmarks that Bain case teams and external customers use to identify performance gaps and prioritize where to improve. The Senior Associate will work as a hands-on data engineer on the OPEXEngine data team, supporting end-to-end delivery across data ingestion and validation, metric calculation, and cohort and benchmark creation, while ensuring high-quality, scalable, and reliable data solutions. 
 What you ll do This role requires strong hands-on experience in SQL, Python, relational data modeling, and data warehousing. The candidate will design and implement data pipelines, data models, and validation workflows, and is expected to scope features and make architecture decisions rather than execute only within a pre-defined scope. The role includes active participation in project planning, stakeholder communication, and quality assurance to support timely delivery of high-impact work. Full-week coverage is required, with overlap into US working hours to support the onshore team. The BCN Senior Associate will work closely with team managers, OPEXEngine Strategy & Ops leadership, Bain case teams, and external customers to build and deliver scalable, automated, and commercially relevant data solutions. The working style of the team is centered on scalable product and capability development; therefore, pipelines and data solutions built in this role should be robust, automated, and designed for long-term maintainability. The individual should also be comfortable creating structure in ambiguity. Essential Functions: Validate incoming customer submissions for structural accuracy and consistency with the OPEXEngine taxonomy, flagging exceptions for review. Load validated responses into the OPEXEngine database and action corrections arising from customer feedback or direction from Strategy & Ops. Write and optimize SQL-based queries and transformations to support metric calculations, data checks, and deliverables for Bain case teams and external customers. Operationalize the annual benchmarking cycle: build cohorts from defined selection criteria, calculate benchmarks and quartiles, validate the output, and ensure it is published to the platform. Design and execute data cleaning rules that improve structural validity across the benchmark database. Scope, design, and build platform features that strengthen the data pipeline, such as validation tooling that flags taxonomy breaks and percentile performance views across the database. Make schema and architecture decisions across the ingestion, metric calculation, and benchmarking pipeline, ensuring solutions are scalable, automated, and maintainable. Gather business requirements and process knowledge from Strategy & Ops, and translate them into scalable data models, transformations, and outputs aligned to end-user needs. Investigate data issues within the pipeline, identify root causes, communicate implications to stakeholders, and propose effective solutions. Prepare clear technical and process documentation for ongoing maintenance, knowledge transfer, and future reference. Manage communication with onshore teams and stakeholders regarding project progress, data quality, and key insights. Support project planning and resource management, including prioritization, work allocation, and tracking progress across concurrent initiatives. Provide technical guidance and day-to-day support to junior team members, review output for quality, and drive reusable capability building through shared assets, frameworks, and documentation standards. 
 About you Work experience: 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Management, Business Intelligence, or Business Analytics, with strong hands-on experience in SQL, Python, data warehousing, and relational database design. Education Required: Incumbent should be a graduate/post graduate from a top-tier institute or have pursued a statistical/analytical course from a tier 1 university. Preferred: Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required: Advanced SQL knowledge (complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, optimization, etc.). Strong hands-on Python for data processing, validation, automation, and scripting. Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data warehousing principles, and relational database architecture, with hands-on experience on SQL server or a comparable relational database. Working knowledge of cloud technologies, preferably AWS (e.g., EC2, RDS, CloudWatch). Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, and scalable data pipeline architecture. Ability to independently scope features, design solutions, and make architecture decisions, including where requirements start out ambiguous. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD workflows; GitLab experience preferred. Experience coordinating projects, managing resources, and driving execution across multiple stakeholders. Ability to provide technical leadership, coach junior team members, and review output for quality and accuracy. Strong organizational skills, including planning, prioritization, and time management. High attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Passion for solving complex data problems and working with large, diverse data sets. Ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and business contexts. Good to have (not mandatory): SaaS domain expertise or P&L fluency, and prior experience with benchmarking or survey-based data sets. Good to have (not mandatory) : familiarity with PHP or JavaScript/React for full-stack contribution, and exposure to LLM/API integration. 
 What makes us a great place to work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the worlds best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoors list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents .

Its culture values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. The rapidly growing center is now home to more than 1,000 professionals. 
 About the Role As a Senior Associate, Data Engineer within the Business Intelligence Unit, you will own the data foundations that power analytics, reporting, applications, and emerging AI/ML use cases. This hands-on onsite role combines production engineering, data modelling, platform optimisation, and stakeholder partnership. You will strengthen existing SQL Server pipelines, support the transition to Snowflake and dbt, and embed disciplined engineering practices across the BIU.
